assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Individual landscape portfolio cover, 1600x1000 or similar 8:5 aspect ratio, a finished standalone raster image for a Notion page cover and project card.
Primary request: Create a polished minimal flat vector-style conceptual illustration for the Korean software project WISEOP. Match a calm editorial portfolio aesthetic: clean rounded cards, fine lines, pale sage background #e7eee7, forest green #236a50, muted warm gray text, subtle geometric grid, generous breathing space. No photography, no 3D, no glossy gradients.
Subject: Abstract geographic grid with 4 translucent sage hexagons representing demand, three simple round vehicle/location markers, and a dashed straight schematic connector (not an actual road route). A small white rounded workflow panel beside the map shows three stages. The image should communicate a human-operated demand/vehicle/redeployment planning web application.
Composition: Modern balanced 2D layout. Map occupies left 60%, small workflow panel at center right. Keep all essential marks and text in the central horizontal band, at least 10% margin from outer edges, so the image survives a wide Notion cover crop. Nothing tilted. Do not draw a full literal software screenshot or browser chrome. Sparse, clear content readable at card size.
Text (verbatim, exactly these strings, no extra text):
"WISEOP"
"수요 · 차량 · 재배치"
"확인 → 계획 → 진행"
"구성 일러스트 · 실제 화면 아님"
Typography: precise clean Korean sans-serif. WISEOP small upper-left within composition, Korean topic line below. Put the last disclosure in a small but readable white pill near the center-bottom of the main composition, not at the extreme image edge.
Constraints: Concept only, no real map/street names, no exact coordinates, no names or identifiers, no numbers or statistics, no prediction accuracy or completed dispatch claims, no route optimization/ETA indications, no logos, no watermark. Do not include any UI outside this one image.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One finished standalone landscape raster portfolio cover, approximately 1600x1000, 8:5 composition, for a Notion page cover and the Paju project card.
Primary request: Create an elegant conceptual illustration for a Korean accessible-transport voucher mobile WebView and administrator frontend project. Match the established calm editorial software-portfolio visual system: softly textured pale backgrounds, precise flat vector-like drawing, white rounded cards, thin outlines, restrained sage and forest green, generous breathing room, clear Korean sans-serif. No photography, no 3D, no glossy effects. Use a warm ivory #eee9df background with subtle sand tones, forest green #254737, muted sage accents and a small muted amber destination pin. Make this visually distinct from a demand/redeployment dashboard and from a multi-portal subscription SaaS.
Subject and hierarchy: A large upright smartphone occupies the left-center. Its simplified mobile screen shows a heading for a trip request, two clear origin/destination input rows, a compact schematic map with two pins and one simple connecting path, and a small trip-history card below. On the right, a smaller desktop-style rounded administrator panel shows two anonymous account cards, a person icon on each, linked by a thin neutral connector; this represents a human selecting and linking a web member and a center member, not automatic approval. Keep all content schematic and spare, readable at thumbnail size.
Composition: Balanced front-facing planar layout, nothing dramatically tilted. A small project heading at the upper left; phone and admin panel centered in the main 65% of the composition. Essential subjects and wording stay at least 10% from image edges. Leave a calm 12% bottom margin. Place the disclosure in a white rounded pill around 82%-87% of image height, large enough to read at card size.
Text (verbatim, only these strings, no invented copy):
"파주 바우처"
"모바일 이용자 · 관리자"

assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: One finished standalone landscape PNG portfolio project cover, approximately 1600×1000, 8:5 aspect ratio. New image, not an edit.
Primary request: Create a polished, restrained conceptual illustration for WISEVCS, a browser-based operator trip-intake frontend. It translates an existing desktop operations intake workflow to the web. Communicate that HTTP handles business requests, while WebSocket receives server-side record changes and updates a browser list. Do not depict an actual production screenshot.
Style and palette: Calm editorial flat vector-like raster illustration matching a Korean developer portfolio. Warm cream and very pale sage background, forest/deep green, muted warm gray typography, rounded off-white panels, fine clean outlines, very subtle paper texture, generous space, crisp readable Korean sans-serif. No photography, photorealism, people, 3D, glossy gradients, neon, or dark background.
Composition: Balanced wide canvas. Upper-left large dark-green WISEVCS, immediately below the exact subtitle. Left half: one simple frontal browser panel labeled "접수 목록", with three anonymous horizontal placeholder rows; small conceptual status badges "추가", "갱신", "삭제". These are abstract bars without names, IDs, addresses or numbers. At the bottom inside this browser panel, show a short small process "변환 → 병합 → 갱신". Right side: one abstract rounded business-server icon, labeled "업무 서버". Keep a clear gap between browser and server for two separate communication arrows.
Crucial technical directions:
1. TOP thin subdued arrow: starts at the LEFT browser and points RIGHT into the server. Exactly one arrowhead, on its RIGHT end. Label "HTTP" and "업무 요청". This is browser → server.
2. BELOW it, the MAIN stronger forest-green arrow: starts at the RIGHT server and points LEFT into the browser. Exactly one arrowhead, on its LEFT end, clearly touching/entering the browser side. Label "WebSocket" and "변경 수신". This is server → browser. Make the returning green arrow visually dominant.
Never swap these directions, never use double-headed arrows, never draw an extra loop that confuses the two flows. Keep arrowheads and words separate, clear and unoccluded.
Text (verbatim, exactly these strings, no other text):
"WISEVCS"
"웹 접수 · 실시간 동기화"
"접수 목록"
"추가"
"갱신"
"삭제"
"변환 → 병합 → 갱신"
"업무 서버"
"HTTP"
"업무 요청"
"WebSocket"
"변경 수신"
"구성 일러스트 · 실제 화면 아님"
Typography: Large confident WISEVCS and subtitle, clear protocol labels, no tiny explanatory paragraphs. The required final disclosure "구성 일러스트 · 실제 화면 아님" must be a LARGE high-contrast readable white rounded pill centered below the main composition, comfortably inside the canvas, not against the lower edge. It must remain recognizable at project-card thumbnail size. Essential title, arrows and footer must have at least 8–10% safe margins. Keep the full design inside the frame with no clipping.
Avoid: automatic dispatch or optimization, demand forecasting, H3 hexagon maps, GPS tracking paths, mobile devices/apps, human figures, checkmarks implying completed service, customer/driver/personal data, realistic browser URL bars, actual IDs/phone/address/account values, tokens, URLs, performance numbers, charts or percentages, unsupported features, company or technology logos, extra slogans, watermark. This is a clear conceptual operator-intake and WebSocket receive illustration only.
